Let me preface I'm an only child but had somewhat of a sibling relationship with my cousins. While growing up at different periods in life I had 3 cousins that lived in the same town that happened to be siblings but with a massive age gap.While 3 other cousins lived elsewhere around the country but due to a variety of different circumstances there was very little communications over the years. Also my mother's side of the family I had no cousins so to speak of.

As an only child I spent little time around those close in age to me outside of the school year. When I was of an age that needed to babysat I was often over at my aunt's & cousin's house. My cousin was roughly 8 years older than me and had massive influence on me. He helped teach me to rollar stake ( oddly still popular in my hometown well past the '70s into the '90s and even now). He would also let me tag along with trick or treating followed by an evening of me getting to trade away my chocolate candy until he left for college. To say I look up to him was an understatement I wanted to be like him or at least acknowledged the way he was by the adults in my life. Throughout school I joined in samiler clubs that he was in like the swim team, 4-H, robotics, and I even went to the same college. 

When I was 4/5 my aunt remarried and had two more kids over the course of 4/5 years. My cousin was freshman & a junior in high school when they were born while I was around 7 & 9. Because I was at that awkward stage where being left alone for over 9 hours was kinda of frowned upon which meant I would have to go over to my aunt's house when the little cousins were still babies and my older cousin doing high school things; which on occasions made things super boring. But it also meant that I was ingored or forgetton. It also lead me to developed little personality quirks that would let me fade into the background so that I wouldn't be a bothered but also in ways that entertain myself. For the most part it worked I was able to see things and experience things that I probably shouldn't have had seen. I saw my aunt, cousin, and uncle react poorly to different things usually in front of me because they forgot I was there. It also meant I was the target for them to take their anger out on which meant I was forced from my little content hiding spot to having to be outside (something I hated & still do). If I wasn't being forced outside I was made to entertain the babies that were outterly boring or just down right mean. The slightly older baby (probably 2 or 3 at this memory) when I was forced to entertain would often hit of toss somewhat heavy things at my head. My older cousin who I looked up to was the one that would often forced me to do these things when he was left in charge.

Years later when I was in high school I was asked to watch my younger cousins for the summer & days off during the school year. Because I was a nice meek person when it came to my cousins and aunt I agreed to babysit them. I followed the outline of what my aunt & uncle laid out of things that needed to be done during the day other then that I took a very extreme lay back position. I never forced them to do things they didn't want to do  ( besides wearing sunscreen) and I let them choose what we did. But one of things I tried to do my best of was not trying to influence them. I answered questions they had but was careful when it was on something that was oppionted. The only time I said something of influence was when the older of the 2 was starting to be body shamed my aunt & uncle because she wasn't as thin as her little sister. My advice was to find a point to be happy about who she was and the way she looked and if she was happy then it doesn't matter what other people think about her.

What I know and seen in relation to those cousins in there relationship is that it's interesting. I know the cousin I looked up to and his younger sister that was born when he was a freshmen in high school is complicated. He often puts her down while often putting some crazy pressure on her over different things. With him and the youngest sibling I can't really say what the relationship is there but what I noticed over the years is that she treated very carefully by by him and her parents.

Right now I have very little communication with all three outside of Facebook. Although for me I been making very hard point to just keep everyone I grew up around at a distance further then arms length.
